tagline: Mechanistic Subnetwork Pruning: Diagnosing and recovering from catastrophic layer sensitivity in transformers — scaling to Mistral-7B with true hardware compression.
research_question: Can Contrastive Circuit Sparing isolate and protect mathematically dense neurons during 20% width pruning, achieving zero-shot reasoning preservation without expensive LoRA healing?

overview.title: What we're building
overview.body: A structured pruning + activation healing pipeline (TIM-MGDT) that identifies which transformer layers and MLP widths are elastic vs critical. By exploiting the 'Hardware-Aligned Structural Lottery Ticket' hypothesis, we prune models like Mistral-7B using FIM metrics while fully preserving zero-shot reasoning (GSM8K) capabilities.

overview.title: Why this matters
overview.body: Existing pruning methods either destroy quality or require expensive retraining. We recently tested 'Hardware-Aligned Width Pruning' and discovered the 'Perplexity Trap': FIM metrics based on general text effectively overwrite and destroy rare mathematical reasoning circuits. We are now testing 'Contrastive Circuit Sparing' to surgically isolate and protect these logic pathways.

overview.title: Where we are today
overview.body: Phase 17 active. We discovered that Phase 16 width pruning crashed GSM8K reasoning from 38% to 5% because general text FIM actively deletes reasoning neurons. We are now implementing Contrastive Circuit Sparing to protect math circuits during 20% width pruning.

decisions.rationale: We shifted focus entirely from toy models like GPT-2 to Mistral-7B, proving our pipeline on state-of-the-art reasoning architectures used in modern deployments.

decisions.choice: FIM Width Pruning over Depth Pruning
decisions.rationale: Depth pruning (layer dropping) creates sharp, localized discontinuities ('Perplexity Trap'). Width pruning (MLP dimensionality reduction) guided by Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) preserves the structural manifold and retains zero-shot logical reasoning better.
To ensure theoretical FLOP reductions translate to physical speedups, we round pruned MLP dimensions to nearest 64 (Tensor Core alignment) via specific ceil/floor strategies.

tasks.next_action: A smart parallel script is currently utilizing both RTX 3090s to calculate FIM, prune Mistral-7B with `ceil` and `floor` strategies, and evaluate GSM8K zero-shot recovery simultaneously.
A remote feedback distillation task running externally is waiting for Edward's endpoint (~12h remaining). Our local hardware will pivot to robust evaluation generation once Phase 16 finishes.
